This site collects analyses, methods, and software I have built during my PhD and earlier training. Each project page states the question, the data and reference versions, the methods and parameters, the QC decisions, and a link to the code repository. Everything listed here is open; unpublished data and results from manuscripts in preparation are not included.

## Featured

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [VennCompare](projects/venn-compare.qmd)
Browser-only set comparison with exact overlap statistics (Fisher's exact, hypergeometric via SuperExactTest, BH-FDR), UpSet and Venn plots, and reproducible R code export. Runs on Quarto + Shinylive; no data leaves the browser.
[Open the app](https://somatogenomics.github.io/venn-compare/) · [Source](https://github.com/Somatogenomics/venn-compare)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [poolAD](projects/poolad.qmd)
R package for parsing allele-depth (AD) fields from pooled-sequencing VCF/GATK tables without silent type coercion, with pooling-aware allele-frequency statistics and a Snakemake command-line entry point.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [Forced-heterozygosity pool-seq mapping](projects/forced-heterozygosity.qmd)
A bulk-segregant design and analysis workflow for mapping recessive alleles when the affected class cannot be sampled directly: engineer the cross so the allele must be heterozygous in one pool and absent in the other, then test allele-depth differences per site.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [Multi-layer bulk RNA-seq workflow](projects/transgenic-rnaseq.qmd)
Differential expression (DESeq2, limma, edgeR), transcript usage (IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR + satuRn, DEXSeq), splicing (rMATS), co-expression (WGCNA), and regulatory-network inference (GENIE3) on *Aedes aegypti* AaegL5.0. Code and configuration only; data are not yet public.
:::

:::
